WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    c.country,
    AVG(ds.wins) as race_avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_avg_wins) as country_avg_wins
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM country_averages
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.country,
    ca.country_avg_wins,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM country_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ca.country_avg_wins > oa.overall_avg
),
group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as group_avg FROM above_overall
),
final_candidates AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.country,
    ao.country_avg_wins,
    ao.overall_avg,
    ga.group_avg
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN group_avg ga
  WHERE ao.country_avg_wins > ga.group_avg
)
SELECT 
  country,
  country_avg_wins,
  country_avg_wins - overall_avg as above_overall,
  country_avg_wins - group_avg as above_group
FROM final_candidates
ORDER BY country_avg_wins DESC;
